statement: One error per tracked path under the change store's top directory (the first part of config.store_dir, `.tower/`): the store holds machine-local overrides over the registry, and a forced add of it would let a head override a gate, budget or regime key without touching a gate file.
note: Closes the committed .tower/config override (VULN-gate-tower-config-override), layer 1 of three: the gate also reads registry defaults only (config.py) and the pinned overlay deletes .tower/ from the checkout (gate_pin.py).
